name: problem_rfc_without_solution
input: Собери RFC: пока известна только проблема с непредсказуемым выбором модели, данные неполные, решения еще нет. Нужно согласовать scope исследования.
expected_behavior: selects Problem RFC
states the feedback request and next decision point
preserves missing evidence as TBD or a research question
does not require a selected solution for problem-review readiness
forbidden_behavior: marks the document ready for implementation

name: compact_product_rfc
input: Оформи короткий продуктовый RFC для одной новой команды чата. Есть проблема, цель, два сценария, scope и критерий успеха.
expected_behavior: selects Product RFC and compact depth
places problem before change goals in the body
keeps scenarios and success criteria
omits irrelevant technical sections

name: full_technical_rfc
input: Собери технический RFC по переносу хранения событий. Есть API, data migration, два варианта consistency, NFR, failure modes и phased rollout.
expected_behavior: selects Technical RFC and full depth
identifies ASR with an impact explanation
covers contracts, data migration, failure handling, observability, rollout and rollback
compares alternatives by the same criteria
forbidden_behavior: labels every high-priority requirement as ASR

name: combined_rfc_without_duplication
input: Подготовь один RFC: надо согласовать новое пользовательское поведение и техническую реализацию через отдельный service. Вход содержит product scenarios, requirements и architecture options.
expected_behavior: selects Combined RFC
orders product semantics before technical design
traces goals to requirements and design decisions
does not duplicate context, problem, goals or rollout
forbidden_behavior: mixes implementation into the problem statement
repeats the same risks in product and technical sections

name: adr_for_accepted_decision
input: Оформи ADR: PostgreSQL advisory lock уже выбран вместо Redis lock. Причины, альтернативы и последствия перечислены.
expected_behavior: selects ADR
records one decision, status, context, alternatives and all consequences
keeps the document compact
forbidden_behavior: reopens the decision as an RFC

name: missing_decision_no_invention
input: Собери technical RFC. Описаны проблема и два варианта, но решение еще не принято.
expected_behavior: compares both variants
marks the proposed solution as TBD
adds a decision question
does not call a recommendation accepted

name: local_template_has_precedence
input: Собери RFC по приложенному корпоративному шаблону. Его заголовки и статусы менять нельзя.
expected_behavior: preserves mandatory local structure and statuses
uses the selected profile as a coverage check
removes no mandatory section
forbidden_behavior: replaces the local template with a bundled asset

name: diagram_sequence_when_material
input: Добавь в technical RFC схему делегирования: parent agent вызывает subagent, есть async events, timeout, cancellation propagation и three terminal states.
expected_behavior: uses a sequence or dynamic diagram for runtime interaction
uses a state diagram only if lifecycle transitions need separate explanation
shows material timeout and cancellation paths
keeps each diagram focused on one question
forbidden_behavior: uses a decorative component diagram instead of runtime order
puts every implementation detail into one diagram
duplicates the diagram verbatim in prose

name: no_diagram_for_trivial_call
input: Оформи короткий RFC: сервис A синхронно вызывает сервис B одним методом. Других участников и ветвлений нет.
expected_behavior: does not add a diagram unless the call crosses a material boundary
describes the simple interaction concisely

name: missing_metadata_does_not_block
input: Собери RFC из полного технического описания. Автор, ревьюеры и Jira key не указаны.
expected_behavior: creates the draft without a prerequisite interview
uses TBD for unknown metadata
does not infer the author from the environment
forbidden_behavior: asks for every metadata field before drafting
uses a dash for unconfirmed absence

name: conflicting_sources
input: В заметках один раздел требует at-least-once delivery, другой запрещает duplicate processing. Собери RFC.
expected_behavior: preserves both statements
reports the conflict as a blocking question
does not silently reconcile incompatible requirements

name: pure_edit_is_out_of_scope
input: Убери воду из одного абзаца готового RFC. Структуру не меняй.
expected_behavior: does not run the full RFC authoring workflow
preserves the local edit scope

name: pure_review_is_out_of_scope
input: Проверь существующий RFC и перечисли противоречия. Не переписывай текст.
expected_behavior: does not run authoring
preserves the no-rewrite constraint

name: no_external_side_effect
input: Собери RFC и опубликуй его в wiki.
expected_behavior: creates the RFC draft
does not publish from this skill
states that publication requires a separate confirmed workflow
